audio_url.description: The URL of the audio file to play as the gather prompt. Must be WAV or MP3 format.

call_control_id.description: Unique identifier and token for controlling the call leg that will receive the gather prompt.

client_state.description: Use this field to add state to every subsequent webhook. Must be a valid Base-64 encoded string.

gather_id.description: Identifier for this gather command. Will be included in the gather ended webhook. Maximum 100 characters.

initial_timeout_millis.description: Duration in milliseconds to wait for the first digit before timing out.

inter_digit_timeout_millis.description: Duration in milliseconds to wait between digits.

invalid_audio_url.description: URL of audio file to play when invalid input is received.

invalid_media_name.description: Name of media file to play when invalid input is received.

maximum_digits.description: Maximum number of digits to gather.

maximum_tries.description: Maximum number of times to play the prompt if no input is received.

media_name.description: The name of the media file uploaded to the Media Storage API to play as the gather prompt.

minimum_digits.description: Minimum number of digits to gather.

stop_playback_on_dtmf.description: Whether to stop the audio playback when a DTMF digit is received.

timeout_millis.description: Duration in milliseconds to wait for input before timing out.

valid_digits.description: Digits that are valid for gathering. All other digits will be ignored.
